title: Kanban Board
summary: Kanban board with three columns (In Progress, In Review, Done) each containing task cards with titles, colored labels/chips, user avatar assignments, attachment counts, and comment counts. Cards include images (e.g., a plant photo). Each column has an 'Add New Item' button at the bottom. Right-side 'Edit Task' drawer with title field, due date, label chips, and comment box.

layout.columns: 3 equal kanban columns side by side, plus a right-side edit drawer
